verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies that Justworks handles payroll tax work itself. It collects employee withholding and filing-status data in place of W-4s, has customers report outside payments before quarterly adjustment deadlines, and asks for prior payroll history under the company EIN. None of the evidence explicitly states that Justworks automatically calculates, files, and remits federal, state, and local taxes. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic tax calculation, filing, and remittance; coverage of state and local jurisdictions; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have federal, state, and local payroll taxes calculated, filed, and remitted automatically

citations.quote: Justworks collects your employees' filing status, withholding, and exemption information when they enroll with Justworks, so that they don't need to file a W-4 themselves.
